==English==
{{wikidata lexeme|L5865}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:af|complete|-ly<id:adverbial>|text=+|tree=1}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/kəmˈpliːtli/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-completely.ogg|a=US}}
* {{hyphenation|en|com|plete|ly}}

===Adverb===
{{en-adv}}

# {{senseid|en|manner}} In a [[complete]] manner; [[thoroughly]].
#: {{ux|en|Please '''completely''' fill in the box for your answer, using a number “2” pencil.}}
#: {{ux|en|I will have '''completely''' finished my degree by next July, when my thesis has been properly edited.}}
#* {{RQ:Melville Moby-Dick|chapter=70|passage=It should not have been omitted that previous to '''completely''' stripping the body of the leviathan, he was beheaded.}}
#* {{RQ:Chopin Awakening|chapter=XIX|passage=She '''completely''' abandoned her Tuesdays at home, and did not return the visits of those who had called upon her.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1969|author=E.R. Zumwalt, Jr.|title=s:Silver Star Citation - John Kerry
|passage=Lieutenant (junior grade) KERRY immediately maneuvered his craft through several strafing runs which '''completely''' silenced the enemy.}}
#* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Elisabeth Buchwald and Ramishah Maruf|title=A massive tariff on millions of Americans’ purchases just went into effect — cue the chaos|url=https://www.cnn.com/2025/05/02/economy/de-minimis-packages-tariff|date=2025-05-02|passage=“Temu is gone! What I saw today '''completely''' convinced me!” the user wrote. “Local sellers, despite obviously buying some items in advance in a bulk, don’t have all these items I was ﻿interested in.”|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260514181120/https://www.cnn.com/2025/05/02/economy/de-minimis-packages-tariff|archivedate=14 May 2026}}
# {{senseid|en|degree}} To the fullest extent or degree; [[totally]].
#: {{ux|en|He is '''completely''' mad.}}
#* {{RQ:Churchill Celebrity|chapter=2|passage=I had occasion […] to make a somewhat long business trip to Chicago, and on my return […] I found Farrar awaiting me in the railway station. He smiled his wonted fraction by way of greeting, […], and finally leading me to his buggy, turned and drove out of town. I was '''completely''' mystified at such an unusual proceeding.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|date=1968-06-08|author={{w|Ted Kennedy|Edward M. Kennedy}}|title=s:Tribute to Senator Robert F. Kennedy
|passage=Our future may lie beyond our vision, but it is not '''completely''' beyond our control.}}
#* '''1975''', {{w|Helen Schucman}}, ''[[s:A Course in Miracles/Workbook for Students/The light has come|A Course in Miracles/Workbook for Students]]'', Lesson 75: ''The light has come'',

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|in a complete manner}} {{l|en|fully}}, {{l|en|totally}}, {{l|en|utterly}}
* {{sense|to the fullest degree}} {{l|en|fully}}, {{l|en|totally}}, {{l|en|utterly}}
* See also [[Thesaurus:completely]]

====Derived terms====
* {{l|en|completely and utterly}}
* {{l|en|completely metrizable}}
